outputComponents.text:
I've wired up your project into an interactive prototype. You can now click through the full technician flow using the following navigation:

### Interactive Flow:
*   **Login**: The «Войти» button now leads directly to your **Inbox**.
*   **Inbox**: 
    *   Tapping the **settings gear** opens the **Settings** screen.
    *   Clicking on any **task card** takes you to the **Task Details**.
    *   The **bottom navigation** allows switching to **Closed Tasks**.
*   **Task Details**: The «Назад» (Back) button and the bottom navigation return you to the **Inbox** or switch to **Closed Tasks**.
*   **Closed Tasks**: Mirroring the Inbox, you can access **Settings**, view **Task Details**, or switch back to the **Inbox**.
*   **Settings**: The «Назад» button returns you to the **Inbox**, and I've ensured the bottom navigation is hidden here to focus on user account actions.

The Beltelecom brand palette (#663479 purple, #33CEE1 cyan) and Russian labels have been strictly preserved throughout. You can test these interactions directly in the Stitch preview.
